source.text_it: Nel freno idraulico la forza frenante è trasmessa agli elementi frenanti da un liquido

records.localized_text: In hydraulic brakes, braking force is transmitted to the braking elements by fluid.

source.text_it: Il circuito frenante nei mezzi pesanti muniti di freno pneumatico utilizza l'aria accumulata in appositi serbatoi

records.localized_text: The braking circuit of heavy vehicles with pneumatic brakes uses air stored in dedicated tanks.

source.text_it: Il freno pneumatico utilizza l'aria compressa preventivamente accumulata in appositi serbatoi

records.localized_text: Pneumatic brakes use compressed air previously stored in dedicated tanks.

source.text_it: Nell'impianto frenante pneumatico integrale i serbatoi contengono olio per il circuito frenante

records.localized_text: In a full pneumatic braking system, the tanks contain oil for the brake circuit.

source.text_it: Nel freno pneumatico la forza frenante è fornita dalla pressione di aria

records.localized_text: In pneumatic brakes, braking force is supplied by air pressure.

source.text_it: L'anticongelatore dell'impianto frenante di tipo pneumatico evita la formazione di ghiaccio all'interno del circuito

records.localized_text: The antifreeze device in a pneumatic braking system prevents ice forming inside the circuit.

source.text_it: La pressione dell'aria accumulata nei serbatoi dell'impianto pneumatico di frenatura viene segnalata da apposito manometro in cabina

records.localized_text: A dedicated cab pressure gauge indicates the air pressure stored in the pneumatic braking system's tanks.

source.text_it: Il manometro dell'olio misura la pressione dell'olio dell'impianto frenante

records.localized_text: The oil pressure gauge measures the oil pressure in the braking system.

source.text_it: Il manometro dell'impianto frenante indica la pressione dell'acqua

records.localized_text: The braking system pressure gauge indicates water pressure.

source.text_it: Talune anomalie dell'impianto frenante sono rilevabili attraverso il controllo del manometro

records.localized_text: Some braking system faults can be detected by checking the pressure gauge.

source.text_it: La pressione dell'aria all'interno di ciascun serbatoio del circuito frenante è segnalata dall'apposito manometro

records.localized_text: A dedicated pressure gauge indicates the air pressure inside each brake circuit tank.

source.text_it: Il manometro dell'impianto frenante indica la pressione nei serbatoi dell'aria dell'impianto frenante

records.localized_text: The braking system pressure gauge indicates the pressure in its air tanks.

source.text_it: Il freno pneumatico di frenatura sfrutta l'incomprimibilità dell'aria

records.localized_text: Pneumatic braking exploits the incompressibility of air.

source.text_it: Dal controllo del manometro dell'impianto di frenatura il conducente verifica che la pressione dell'aria sia compresa tra i valori minimo e massimo prescritti

records.localized_text: By checking the braking system pressure gauge, the driver verifies that air pressure is between the specified minimum and maximum values.

source.text_it: La temperatura dell'aria all'interno del serbatoio del circuito frenante pneumatico è segnalata dall'apposito manometro

records.localized_text: A dedicated pressure gauge indicates the air temperature inside the pneumatic brake circuit tank.

source.text_it: Talune anomalie dell'impianto di raffreddamento sono rilevabili attraverso il controllo del manometro dell'aria

records.localized_text: Some cooling system faults can be detected by checking the air pressure gauge.

source.text_it: Il compressore dell'impianto frenante pneumatico comprime l'olio destinato ad agire sugli elementi frenanti

records.localized_text: The pneumatic braking system compressor compresses oil intended to act on the braking elements.

source.text_it: Il compressore dell'impianto frenante pneumatico aspira e comprime aria

records.localized_text: The pneumatic braking system compressor draws in and compresses air.

source.text_it: Il compressore dell'impianto frenante pneumatico riceve il movimento dall'albero motore

records.localized_text: The pneumatic braking system compressor is driven by the crankshaft.

source.text_it: Il compressore dell'impianto frenante pneumatico riceve il movimento dell'albero di trasmissione

records.localized_text: The pneumatic braking system compressor is driven by the transmission shaft.

source.text_it: Il compressore dell'impianto frenante pneumatico è costituito da satelliti e da planetari

records.localized_text: The pneumatic braking system compressor consists of planet and sun gears.

source.text_it: Il depuratore dell'impianto frenante pneumatico elimina le impurità che si trovano in sospensione nell'aria compressa

records.localized_text: The pneumatic braking system purifier removes impurities suspended in the compressed air.

source.text_it: La presenza di impurità nel serbatoio dell'aria dell'impianto frenante pneumatico è misurata da un apposito manometro

records.localized_text: A dedicated pressure gauge measures impurities in the pneumatic braking system air tank.

source.text_it: L'anticongelatore dell'impianto frenante pneumatico evita che l'olio contenuto nel convertitore ghiacci

records.localized_text: The pneumatic braking system antifreeze device prevents oil in the converter from freezing.

source.text_it: Il depuratore dell'impianto frenante pneumatico depura le impurità nell'olio contenute nel convertitore

records.localized_text: The pneumatic braking system purifier removes impurities from oil in the converter.

rows.text: In a hydraulic circuit, the pedal creates pressure in the fluid, which transmits it to the wheel brake cylinders.
evidence: https://www.chp.ca.gov/siteassets/policy/hpg/hpg-83.2-ch-5.pdf, hydraulic brakes: il liquido in pressione raggiunge i cilindri delle ruote.

rows.text: The compressor fills reservoirs with compressed air, which the circuit uses to apply the brakes.
evidence: https://uat.ontariogovernment.ca/document/official-air-brake-handbook/air-supply-subsystem, Key points: il compressore comprime aria, accumulata nei serbatoi; https://www.gov.nl.ca/airbrakemanual/print-guide/, Foot Valve e Brake Chambers: aria dal serbatoio aziona i freni.

rows.text: Air is compressed and stored in reservoirs before being sent to the brake chambers.
evidence: https://uat.ontariogovernment.ca/document/official-air-brake-handbook/air-supply-subsystem, Key points: il compressore comprime aria, accumulata nei serbatoi; https://www.gov.nl.ca/airbrakemanual/print-guide/, Foot Valve e Brake Chambers: aria dal serbatoio aziona i freni.

rows.text: The reservoirs of an air brake system contain compressed air, not oil for braking.
evidence: https://uat.ontariogovernment.ca/document/official-air-brake-handbook/air-supply-subsystem, Key points: il compressore comprime aria, accumulata nei serbatoi; https://www.gov.nl.ca/airbrakemanual/print-guide/, Foot Valve e Brake Chambers: aria dal serbatoio aziona i freni.

rows.text: Air pressure acts on the brake chamber diaphragm, which moves the brake linkage.
evidence: https://www.gov.nl.ca/airbrakemanual/print-guide/, Brake Chambers and Slack Adjusters: la pressione sposta la membrana e l’asta di comando.

rows.text: The antifreeze device introduces vapour into the air to reduce freezing of moisture in the circuit.
evidence: https://uat.ontariogovernment.ca/document/official-air-brake-handbook/air-supply-subsystem, Alcohol evaporator: il vapore di alcol si miscela all’umidità e ne riduce la tendenza a congelare; https://www.nsndepot.com/Files/library/TM/M915/TM-5-3805-254-14-P-2/TM-5-3805-254-14-P-2.pdf, p. 169, AE-1: il vapore entra nel circuito per contrastare il congelamento dell’umidità.

rows.text: The dashboard gauge shows the air pressure in the brake circuit reservoirs.
evidence: https://uat.ontariogovernment.ca/document/official-air-brake-handbook/air-supply-subsystem, Air pressure gauge e Key points: il manometro indica la pressione dei serbatoi primario e secondario.

rows.text: The oil pressure gauge concerns engine oil pressure; the air brake gauge indicates air pressure.
evidence: https://downloads.regulations.gov/NHTSA-2018-0067-12550/attachment_8.pdf, Instruments and controls 2-11, Engine oil pressure gauge: pressione della lubrificazione motore; https://uat.ontariogovernment.ca/document/official-air-brake-handbook/air-supply-subsystem, Air pressure gauge: pressione dell’aria nei serbatoi di servizio.

rows.text: The air brake gauge indicates the air pressure in the reservoirs, not water pressure.
evidence: https://uat.ontariogovernment.ca/document/official-air-brake-handbook/air-supply-subsystem, Air pressure gauge e Key points: il manometro indica la pressione dei serbatoi primario e secondario.

rows.text: An abnormal pressure drop shown by the gauge can indicate a fault, such as an air leak.
evidence: https://www.gov.nl.ca/airbrakemanual/print-guide/, Gauges: variazioni insolite di pressione sono rilevabili; https://uat.ontariogovernment.ca/document/official-air-brake-handbook/inspecting-air-brake-system-operation, air loss test: controllo della perdita di pressione.

rows.text: The quiz marks this TRUE. Gauges show the pressure in the monitored service-brake circuit reservoirs; they may be separate instruments or one gauge with two needles. This does not guarantee an individual reading for every supply or auxiliary tank.
evidence: Official CQC question 31209 printed VERO says each brake-circuit reservoir has a pressure-gauge indication. Interpreting this as the monitored service-circuit reservoirs is a scope qualification, not verified official intent.

Ontario Official Air Brake Handbook, air supply subsystem https://uat.ontariogovernment.ca/document/official-air-brake-handbook/air-supply-subsystem — wet supply and two service reservoirs; separate gauges or one dual-needle gauge for service pressures. Ontario technical guidance, not Italian equipment law.

US 49 CFR 571.121 §§S5.1.2 and S5.1.4 https://www.ecfr.gov/current/title-49/subtitle-B/chapter-V/part-571/subpart-B/section-571.121 — separate supply reservoir and service-system pressure indicators in covered US vehicles; not an Italian legal requirement.

rows.text: The gauge allows the driver to check air pressure stored in the service circuit reservoirs.
evidence: https://uat.ontariogovernment.ca/document/official-air-brake-handbook/air-supply-subsystem, Air pressure gauge e Key points: il manometro indica la pressione dei serbatoi primario e secondario.

rows.text: Air is compressible: the compressor pressurizes it and the stored air operates the brakes.
evidence: https://uat.ontariogovernment.ca/document/official-air-brake-handbook/air-supply-subsystem, Key points: il compressore forza l’aria in uno spazio minore e la immagazzina nei serbatoi; https://www.gov.nl.ca/airbrakemanual/print-guide/, Foot Valve e Brake Chambers: l’aria in pressione aziona i freni.

rows.text: The driver compares the indicated pressure with the operating values specified for the vehicle.
evidence: https://uat.ontariogovernment.ca/document/official-air-brake-handbook/air-supply-subsystem, Air pressure gauge e Key points: controllo della pressione e intervallo di funzionamento; https://uat.ontariogovernment.ca/document/official-air-brake-handbook/inspecting-air-brake-system-operation, governor test: verifica delle pressioni di intervento e arresto.

rows.text: The gauge measures air pressure, not its temperature.
evidence: https://uat.ontariogovernment.ca/document/official-air-brake-handbook/air-supply-subsystem, Air pressure gauge e Key points: il manometro indica la pressione dei serbatoi primario e secondario.

rows.text: The air gauge monitors pressure in the pneumatic brake circuits, not the operation of the engine cooling system.
evidence: https://uat.ontariogovernment.ca/document/official-air-brake-handbook/air-supply-subsystem, Air pressure gauge e Key points: il manometro indica la pressione dei serbatoi primario e secondario.

rows.text: The compressor draws in and compresses air to supply the reservoirs; it does not compress oil to operate the brakes.
evidence: https://www.gov.nl.ca/airbrakemanual/print-guide/, Compressor: il compressore aspira e comprime aria nel cilindro, la invia al serbatoio ed è azionato dal motore mediante cinghie e pulegge o alberi e ingranaggi.

rows.text: The compressor draws in air, compresses it and sends it to the system reservoirs.
evidence: https://www.gov.nl.ca/airbrakemanual/print-guide/, Compressor: il compressore aspira e comprime aria nel cilindro, la invia al serbatoio ed è azionato dal motore mediante cinghie e pulegge o alberi e ingranaggi.

rows.text: The compressor receives motion from the engine crankshaft through drive components, for example belts and pulleys or gears.
evidence: https://patents.google.com/patent/US4129404A/en, Description: compressore per autocarro azionato dall’albero motore mediante cinghie o ingranaggi; https://www.gov.nl.ca/airbrakemanual/print-guide/, Compressor: il motore aziona il compressore mediante cinghie e pulegge o alberi e ingranaggi.

rows.text: The compressor is driven by the engine, not by the driveshaft that carries motion toward the wheels.
evidence: https://www.gov.nl.ca/airbrakemanual/print-guide/, Compressor: il compressore aspira e comprime aria nel cilindro, la invia al serbatoio ed è azionato dal motore mediante cinghie e pulegge o alberi e ingranaggi.

https://www.govinfo.gov/content/pkg/GOVPUB-W-6dfc6e0375832e323235f7e009fd2f76/html/GOVPUB-W-6dfc6e0375832e323235f7e009fd2f76.htm, power transmission: albero di trasmissione verso differenziale e ruote.

rows.text: Spider and side gears belong to the differential. The air compressor typically has pistons that move in cylinders and compress the air.
evidence: https://cbseacademic.nic.in/web_material/Curriculum21/publication/srsec/804-Automotive_Handbook.pdf, pp. 63–64, Differential Assembly e Operation: ingranaggi sun e pinion (planet wheel) nel differenziale; https://www.gov.nl.ca/airbrakemanual/print-guide/, Compressor: pistone nel cilindro comprime aria.

rows.text: The air cleaner treats compressed air, removing contaminants such as moisture and oil particles before they reach the circuit.
evidence: https://www.bendix.com/media/2021/bendix-launches-ad-hfi-air-dryer-with-electronic-pressure-control-capabilities.pdf, PuraGuard: filtro separa gocce d’olio dall’aria compressa; https://uat.ontariogovernment.ca/document/official-air-brake-handbook/air-supply-subsystem, Air dryer: rimozione dell’umidità.

rows.text: The gauge indicates air pressure, not the amount of impurities in the reservoir.
evidence: https://uat.ontariogovernment.ca/document/official-air-brake-handbook/air-supply-subsystem, Air pressure gauge e Key points: il manometro indica la pressione dei serbatoi primario e secondario.

rows.text: The antifreeze device acts on moisture in the circuit air to reduce ice formation, not on oil in a converter.
evidence: https://uat.ontariogovernment.ca/document/official-air-brake-handbook/air-supply-subsystem, Alcohol evaporator: il vapore di alcol si miscela all’umidità e ne riduce la tendenza a congelare; https://www.nsndepot.com/Files/library/TM/M915/TM-5-3805-254-14-P-2/TM-5-3805-254-14-P-2.pdf, p. 169, AE-1: il vapore entra nel circuito per contrastare il congelamento dell’umidità.

rows.text: The air cleaner treats compressed air and its contaminants, not the oil in a converter.
evidence: https://www.bendix.com/media/2021/bendix-launches-ad-hfi-air-dryer-with-electronic-pressure-control-capabilities.pdf, PuraGuard: filtro separa gocce d’olio dall’aria compressa; https://uat.ontariogovernment.ca/document/official-air-brake-handbook/air-supply-subsystem, Air dryer: rimozione dell’umidità.

source_access_notes: Independently inspected Ontario Official Air Brake Handbook air supply subsystem, including service reservoir gauges, dual needles, alcohol evaporator and air dryer, and Newfoundland and Labrador Air Brake Manual compressor and reservoir sections. Manufacturer and California Highway Patrol cited technical guidance checked. 31209 service-circuit interpretation and non-individual-monitoring qualification do not assert that the official intended interpretation is proven. Canadian instructional sources are not Italian equipment law.

issues.reason: Il quesito VERO attribuisce al manometro la pressione di ciascun serbatoio del circuito frenante; le fonti consultate indicano i serbatoi primario e secondario o il serbatoio principale, non dimostrano che sia indicata anche la pressione di ogni ulteriore serbatoio, incluso quello di alimentazione. Occorre chiarire l’ambito inteso dal quesito.
checked_sources: https://uat.ontariogovernment.ca/document/official-air-brake-handbook/air-supply-subsystem, Air pressure gauge e Key points: due pressioni primario/secondario; elenca separatamente il serbatoio di alimentazione.
https://www.gov.nl.ca/airbrakemanual/print-guide/, Gauges: pressione nel sistema del serbatoio principale; non stabilisce indicazione di ogni serbatoio.
